the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# In each demo, what is the relation between 4-shape and the added copy? Show output minus original: cells added.
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    di,do=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    added=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if do[r][c]==4 and di[r][c]!=4]
    removed=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]==4 and do[r][c]!=4]
    print(k,'added:',len(added),'removed:',len(removed), sorted(removed))
    # bounding box of added cells
    rs=[p[0] for p in added]; cs=[p[1] for p in added]
    print(' added bbox rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs))
    # shape center
    cells={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(di) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==4}
    rcs=[p[0] for p in cells]; ccs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    print(' shape bbox rows',min(rcs),max(rcs),'cols',min(ccs),max(ccs),'center',(sum(rcs)/len(rcs),sum(ccs)/len(ccs)))
